<!-- Copilot adapter (L3). Copilot also reads AGENTS.md natively. -->
Follow `AGENTS.md` and the org rules in `.agents/org/org-rules.md`; they override everything else.
Skills are in `.agents/skills/` (installed by `npx skills`); reviewer agents are in `.github/agents/`; hooks are in `.github/hooks/`. All come from the pinned org bundle (`.agents/bundle.lock`), so never edit them here.
